method: DeepFilterNet3 (AI/ML speech enhancement), atten_lim_db=30 (Phase 3 T4 tuning)
dataset: 300 mixtures (3 noise categories x 5 SNR levels x 20 speakers), 48 kHz, synthetic
note_phase3_tuning: This is a REGENERATED evaluation (2026-09-04, Phase 3 T7), superseding the same-day earlier 2026-09-04 manifest-drift-correction version. Phase 3 T4 swept model.atten_lim_db in {30,50,70,85,100} x post_filter in {off,on} on a stratified subset, found atten_lim_db=30/post_filter=off maximises PESQ-WB in all three categories, and confirmed it on the full 300-file set with STOI/SI-SNR staying within a pre-committed 0.005/0.1dB no-regression tolerance (in fact improving on 4 of 6 checks). config/audio_config.yaml's model.atten_lim_db default was changed 100 -> 30 accordingly, so this report now describes the system AS DEPLOYED (tuned), not the untuned atten_lim_db=100 baseline. See progress.md 2026-09-04 'Phase 3 T4 Stage 2' entry, results/atten_sweep.csv, and results/eval_raw_tuned_confirm.csv for full evidence. The untuned (atten_lim_db=100) numbers are preserved in git history and in results/eval_raw.csv/results.csv (unchanged, not deleted) for comparison.
note_manifest_drift_correction: (Same-day, preserved) Earlier on 2026-09-04, data/manifest.csv was found to have drifted from data/mixtures/ on disk (root cause: unsorted glob.glob() in data/mix_dataset.py, fixed at mix_dataset.py:143,156). The base (untuned) dataset/baselines/eval were fully regenerated end to end; stationary and non_stationary category means reproduced byte-identical to the 2026-08-24 report, but impulsive PESQ_WB changed from an unreproducible 2.5841 (2026-08-24) to a reproducible 2.4916 -- this is the 'untuned' baseline that Phase 3 T4 then improved to 2.5428 via atten_lim_db tuning.
note_snr_substitution: PS26052 states 'SNR > 15 dB' as a target. The evaluation uses SI-SNR (Scale-Invariant Signal-to-Noise Ratio) as the practical measurable substitute, because SI-SNR is computed against the paired clean reference (clean_ref_path) from the mixed corpus and is scale-invariant, making it a more rigorous and reproducible substitute than raw segSNR for this synthetic-dataset evaluation. This substitution is stated explicitly and does not apply to any claim about raw SNR on real hardware.
note_pesq_snr_conditional: PESQ-WB is SNR-input-dependent: at higher input SNR the model has less noise to suppress and its outputs score higher. Per-SNR conditional breakdowns are shown in the supplementary section below for context, but the compliance verdict uses the full category mean across all 5 input SNR levels (-5 to +15 dB), which is the correct aggregate for a dataset evaluation.
note_non_stationary_arithmetic: phase3_plan.md Sec 1.1 proves algebraically, from the committed per-subtype numbers (docs/non_stationary_root_cause.md), that non_stationary cannot reach the STOI/SI-SNR targets via post-processing: even a hypothetical zero-damage bypass on crowd babble alone would leave the category STOI mean at 0.8343, still below the 0.85 target, because crowd babble (other human speech) gives a single-channel enhancer no cue to separate target from interferer -- the cocktail-party problem. Phase 3 T6 (see progress.md) further confirmed a reference-assisted (dual-mic) mitigation does not help either once the reference channel is realistically degraded (NLMS's oracle advantage on crowd babble inverts to a large negative SI-SNR under a realistic reference). Non-stationary's 0/3 is reported here as a structural, root-caused, scoped limitation, not a tuning gap.

Driven almost entirely by the crowd/babble subtype (helicopter alone: STOI 0.91, +8.9 dB dSI-SNR, on par with the strongest categories).

non_stationary.PESQ_WB_note: 2.2128 < 2.5 target. Miss margin: 0.287. Improved from 2.1303 (atten=100) but the largest gap across all categories remains here.

STOI/SI-SNR both stayed within the pre-committed 0.005/0.1dB no-regression tolerance (STOI -0.0002, SI-SNR +0.045dB improves).

overall_summary.SI_SNR: 2 of 3 categories PASS (stationary, impulsive). Non-stationary FAILS at 10.86 dB.
overall_summary.STOI: 2 of 3 categories PASS (stationary, impulsive). Non-stationary FAILS at 0.83.
overall_summary.PESQ_WB: 2 of 3 categories PASS (stationary 2.5385, impulsive 2.5428) after Phase 3 T4 tuning (atten_lim_db=30). Non-stationary (2.2128) improves but remains a substantial miss.
overall_summary.verdict: 6 of 9 metric cells PASS (up from 4/9 pre-Phase-3-tuning, up from a previously-reported 5/9 that included an unreproducible impulsive PESQ_WB draw -- see note_manifest_drift_correction). DeepFilterNet3 at atten_lim_db=30 meets all three DRDO targets on stationary AND impulsive noise. Non-stationary noise remains the one structural gap, root-caused to the cocktail-party problem on crowd babble (docs/non_stationary_root_cause.md, phase3_plan.md Sec 1.1) and further shown (Phase 3 T6) to not be rescued by a realistically-degraded dual-mic reference either.
